title: Pd-H miscibility gap and H/D isotope effect from a released ACE potential

decision_points.fork: Fixed-cell versus zero-stress energetics for the H-H interaction
decision_points.wrong_choice: Compute the mixing energies of random PdH_x at the Pd lattice parameter (fixed volume)
decision_points.consequence: Fixed-volume interactions are weak; the mixing energy is convex: Tc ~ 6 K (no gap) and the plateau pressure off by ~6 decades

decision_points.fork: Coherent versus incoherent gap, and which elastic direction controls coherency
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the incoherent Tc as coherent, or use an isotropic/<111> modulus
decision_points.consequence: Tc_coh 419 K or 178 K instead of 282 K

decision_points.fork: Supercell size for dilute quantities (elastic image interaction)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Relax one H in the 4-Pd conventional cell (PdH0.25), at zero pressure or at fixed volume
decision_points.consequence: Solution energy off by -61 / +14 meV, static O-T difference 2 or 80 meV instead of 26 meV

decision_points.fork: Harmonic versus anharmonic quantum treatment of H in the soft octahedral site
decision_points.wrong_choice: Harmonic ZPE from small-displacement curvature (hbar omega = 36 meV)
decision_points.consequence: ZPE(O,H) 53 instead of 88 meV: solution energy -35 meV, K_H/K_D 3.3 instead of 2.27, plateau 1.8 decades low

decision_points.fork: Zero-point energy only versus full vibrational free energy at 300 K for the isotope effect
decision_points.consequence: K_H/K_D 3.16 instead of 2.27 (the soft D mode is thermally excited at 300 K)

decision_points.fork: Site preference with and without ZPE; which site hosts dilute H
decision_points.wrong_choice: Static site energies (or the T site) for the occupancy
decision_points.consequence: T fraction 0.42 instead of 0.013; T-site solution energy/expansion wrong by >0.1 eV / 46%

decision_points.fork: Elastic-only Wagner-Horner mean field versus the full x-dependent energetics (band-filling repulsion)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Tc from the dilute elastic interaction u = B dv^2/v alone

decision_points.fork: Configuration sampling for the random solution
decision_points.wrong_choice: Small ordered 4-Pd cells instead of random occupations in large cells

length_estimate.why: pure-host elastic constants, H2, dilute O/T relaxations with size checks, two 3D frozen-host grids (H/D Schroedinger solves), ~12 random PdH_x zero-stress relaxations plus fits

runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); the ACE potential is evaluated by a pure-numpy port (ace_numpy.py) validated against python-ace 0.4.0rc1
notes: No graded number is archived by the authors: all targets are reference calculations with the released potential through the lab code path (released potential, fresh-style truth). Design adaptations: the ACE H2 molecule is accurate (3 meV vs DFT), so the H2-reference trap was replaced by supplied experimental gas thermochemistry; fixed-volume H-H pair interactions are weakly attractive in this ACE (not repulsive) but the fixed-volume configurational energetics still give no gap; Tc is graded as the mean-field (ideal-entropy) spinodal top of a prompt-defined model because MC/cluster-expansion Tc is not uniquely recoverable; plateau ratio D/H replaced by the dilute Sieverts ratio (equivalent under the stated x-independent vibrations).
